email.subject: AI for Cohen & Buckmann, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Sandra,

Your work on innovative global equity plan design and complex management negotiations in executive compensation puts you at the cutting edge of what boutique firms can deliver. That's exactly why I'm reaching out.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on equity and benefits matters.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
